exposure: number of prior cesarean deliveries (grouped as <=3 vs. >=4)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 15,811 women with singleton pregnancies who underwent a cesarean delivery and had a history of at least one prior cesarean delivery.
finding: Multiple repeat cesarean deliveries, particularly four or more, are significantly associated with increased maternal and neonatal morbidity.
gest_age: Gestational age at delivery was observed to be 37.6 weeks in the group with four or more prior CDs and 38.4 weeks in the group with three or fewer prior CDs.
